output.title: Diwali Party Planning
output.overview: The team met to plan the upcoming Diwali party. It was decided that the event will take place on Friday evening with a set budget of 50,000 rupees. Responsibilities for venue booking and food arrangements were assigned to Ravi and Meera.

decisions.text: The Diwali party will take place on Friday evening.
The budget for the Diwali party is set at 50,000 rupees.
